ARDs taken into a study

Source: R/ard_import.R
ard_imports.Rd

The record of every ARD taken in (import_ard()): import_id, the file in the study's input/ard/ folder, the original file, its source (who made it), format, when it was imported and by which user, its md5, its rows, the outputs it has rows for (its output_id column), the result of the check, and its state ("in use", or "removed" – a removed one stays on the record).

Usage

ard_imports(study)

Arguments

study

An rtfstudy (open_study()).

Value

A data frame, one row per ARD taken in.
